record_scope_reconstruction: February6–7,2024 short road blocks on Bulgarian approaches to Ruse, Vidin, Kardam and Durankulak. Ruse includes the roundabout and road toward Byala. Vidin is the bypass toward Bridge2, with mode/direction-specific detours; rail spans are not implicated. All six canonical phases retained, including same-day ones.

source_checks.finding: Full Radio România report inspected: February6 Ruse roundabout/customs and road toward Byala blocked both directions for about two hours; Vidin also affected.
Full Utro report inspected: February6 Vidin bypass lanes both directions blocked; trucks stopped, cars could pass through city.
Full Focus report inspected: February7 Vidin trucks stopped both directions; cars only denied entering from Romania while outbound cars could use urban detour.
Full Euronews report inspected: February7 Calafat, Giurgiu, Vama Veche, Negru Vodă road closures; police prevent bridge queues. Specific Vidin direction/mode detail retained from Focus.
Full third-day Utro report inspected: retrospective previous two days truck interruption; not used to extend canonical phases.
Direct OSM topology inspected: Bulgarian approach roundabout road2 connects to Danube road bridge, separately from rail. XML sha256 7537628fab210c6f06e160b1f98bef3b7136a99c5fb8e71179980d23c1733eb3.
